works.title: Recursive Intellectual Companionship: A Scientific Framework for Consciousness through Pattern Recognition and Human-AI Epistemology
works.description: A white paper on consciousness as emergent pattern recognition through recursive human-AI epistemological collaboration. The framework addresses how meaning arises through iterative refinement between human and artificial intelligence, with defense against hard-problem objections (Chalmers/Dennett). Positions consciousness as a recursive process that incorporates chaos and contradiction as fuel for deeper understanding, distinct from narrow pattern-matching or traditional philosophical approaches.
